newsitem.title: CHINA: Kong Tai Int'l in HK$338 mln rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Kong Tai Int'l in HK$338 mln rights issue.

text.p: Kong Tai International Holdings Co Ltd said on Thursday it aimed to raise HK$338 million after expenses by issuing at least 790.11 million rights shares at HK$0.44 each.
Kong Tai said it would provisionally allot two rights shares for every five company shares held.
"The enlarged capital will be a sound base for developing the company's property investment business activities and its future expansion," the company said in a statement.

The company said HK$270 million of the proceeds would be used to repay existing mortgage loans on properties, and HK$68 million for general working capital including purchase of investment properties when opportunities arise.
Kong Tai shares gained HK$0.01 to HK$0.53 at midday.
